en: Black-and-white aerial view of a large institutional building complex surrounded by forest and fields. The main structure is an elongated multi-storey building with a central tower and courtyard-like spaces, likely a hospital, with smaller auxiliary buildings nearby. At the bottom left, white caption text is printed over the image indicating the name and location of the place, and at the bottom right there is a small printer or photographer credit with a code.
